title: Broad Art Center floor 1 (main building)

source.publisher: STUDIOpractice (Richard Meier & Partners / STUDIOpractice, the architects; not UCLA)
source.what: "First Floor Plan" of the Eli and Edythe Broad Art Center from the architects' portfolio: walls, stairs, elevators, restroom fixtures, site context; scale bar 25/50/100 ft and north arrow; no room numbers
source.license: architects' portfolio drawing, copyright STUDIOpractice / Richard Meier & Partners; used only to trace wall positions

how: Architects' plan with a 25/50/100 ft scale bar (100 ft = 270 px, 11.25 cm/px) and a north arrow. With that scale, the rotation (-1.9 deg) and position come from fitting the building footprint on the sheet to the building outline (median 2.7 m, 90% within 8.4 m; the outline is OSM's roof line). Check: UCLA GIS restroom 1276 (floor 1) lands in the restroom block at the east end of the main building. Four synthetic control points carry that transform.
notes: The sheet is the architects' "First Floor Plan"; the main (north) building on it is UCLA floor 1 (UCLA GIS restroom 1276, floor 1, lands in its restroom block). The south wing drawn on the same sheet is traced separately as floor 2 (see BROAD-2-wing).
No room numbers on the plan: rooms are unlabeled spaces, corridors, stairs and restrooms.
